lines.x: Bank of Mexico minutes showed policy makers divided over currency depreciation risks after the peso fell 2.26% in a single session and crossed 19 per US dollar.
The Mexican peso weakened past 19 per US dollar, reaching its lowest level in 17 months as policy rate divergence between Banxico and the Fed narrowed their interest rate differential.
Mexico's benchmark stock index fell 1.75% as the peso slid 2.3% and mining shares tumbled amid concerns over US interest rates.
The Mexican peso suffered its worst session in over a year, closing at 18.86 per dollar, as rising expectations that the US Federal Reserve could raise interest rates in December hit the currency.
